label: uom
comment: the unit of measure for the sensor reading, drawn from UNECE rec20 code list.
The unit of measure for the quantity value (eg Kg or meters etc) using the UNECE Rec 20 unit of measure codelist.

rangeIncludes.comment: UNECE Recommendation 20 Unit of Measure code list.

domainIncludes.comment: A data point read by a sensor.

The quantity element is used to define the quantities (eg 100), units of measure (eg Kg) and product class (eg GTIN or other class identifier) of products that are inputs or outputs or the subject of supply chain events.
